battle.name: 塞拉利昂內戰
battle.brief: 中文維基「戰爭列表」收錄的塞拉利昂內戰，於一九九一年三月由弗里敦軍事政變觸發，戰線其後延伸至塞拉利昂東部與南部。本條所列裝備為美國 Sharps rifle，服役年早於一九九一年，屬栓動後膛步槍，是當時美國陸軍步兵武器系統的一環。

kit.name: 施拿甫步槍
kit.history: Sharps rifle 是美國陸軍十九世紀採用的制式肩射步槍，亦供騎兵、民兵與地方武裝使用，屬早期後膛步槍體系的代表型號。

countries: 1991年3月25日，塞拉利昂成為主要戰場，戰事由莫莫政府控制的塞拉利昂軍與福利迪·桑科率領的革命聯合陣線在東部邊境直接引爆。最初進入境內的是桑科的小型武裝隊伍；查爾斯·泰勒指揮的利比里亞愛國陣線則是另一支跨國武裝團體，於同年7月親自率部進入塞拉利昂，並向凱內馬、博城方向進攻。塞拉利昂政府先向尼日利亞求援，9月起由西非經濟共同體多國部隊接管部分防線；幾內亞派出地面部隊，並在南部提供陸地走廊，使法軍得以進入西部。英國於1991年12月執行巴拉斯行動，法國先在1992年執行 impasse 行動，再於1993年執行 pudraque 行動。1992年奪取政權的國家臨時統治委員會並非革命聯合陣線的同一組織；前者一度與武裝反對派聯合，後來卻在內戰中與之交戰。1997年卡巴政府成立後，主要交戰組合轉為塞拉利昂政府軍與聯合國塞拉利昂支援團對抗革命聯合陣線。聯合國部隊雖非國家，卻在1999年至2002年成為政府最重要的地面支柱；英國另於1999年弗里敦戰役中直接出兵。因而這場戰爭雖以塞拉利昂領土為核心，實際上同時牽動利比里亞、幾內亞、尼日利亞、英國、法國及西非共同體的軍事介入。
countriesEn: On 25 March 1991, Sierra Leone became the principal theatre of a war opened by the government forces of President Joseph Saidu Momoh and the Revolutionary United Front under Foday Sankoh along the eastern frontier. Sankoh’s group was initially a small armed movement; the National Patriotic Front of Liberia under Charles Taylor was a separate cross-border organization that entered Sierra Leone with his own troops in July and advanced toward Kenema and Bo. The Sierra Leone government sought Nigerian assistance, and from September the ECOWAS Multinational Force, ECOMOG, took over sections of the front. Guinea supplied contingents and provided a southern land corridor through which French forces entered. Britain mounted Operation Barras in December 1991, while France conducted Operation Impass in 1992 and Operation Boudraque in 1993. The National Provisional Ruling Council that seized power in 1992 was not the same organization as the Revolutionary United Front; it briefly allied with armed opponents before fighting them. After the Kabbah government was established in 1997, the principal alignment became the Sierra Leone government and the United Nations Mission in Sierra Leone, UNAMSIL, against the RUF. Although the United Nations was not a state, its force became the government’s principal ground support from 1999 to 2002, while Britain intervened directly during the 1999 fighting for Freetown. The war was therefore fought principally in Sierra Leone but drew military commitments from Liberia, Guinea, Nigeria, Britain, France and ECOWAS.
people: 福利迪·桑科是革命聯合陣線最具代表性的領袖，曾在利比利亞受訓；他於1991年率二十餘名武裝人員越境，在邊境公路與城鎮據點之間迅速擴張影響，卻也曾一度失去對前線的直接控制。總統約瑟夫·賽杜·莫莫掌握1991年的國家權柄，初期依靠塞拉利昂軍反擊；大衛·蘭辛是當時政府軍最高指揮層的重要人物，負責組織南部與東部的追擊。查爾斯·泰勒則把利比里亞內戰直接帶入塞拉利昂，1991年7月兵敗後仍持續向桑科提供外部支援。1992年4月，瓦倫丁·斯特拉瑟、約翰·阿馬杜·班古拉等推翻莫莫，建立國家臨時統治委員會；斯特拉瑟掌握國家權力至1997年。1995年3月，安德魯·傑克森-史密斯發動政變，尼日利亞干預後莫莫復位；翌年5月，朱利葉斯·馬阿達·比奧與班古拉再度推翻臨時委員會，7月由艾哈邁德·特簡·卡巴接掌國家權力。卡巴政府自此成為抵抗革命聯合陣線及推動聯合國方案的中央。1994年後，伊薩·塞塞在東部重建並指揮革命聯合陣線的野戰部隊；桑科則更多時間在境外活動。戰爭末期的軍事問題因此不只是兩支軍隊對攻，而是斯特拉瑟、比奧等軍事首長，卡巴等政治領導者，桑科、塞塞等反對派指揮官，以及外國聯軍指揮官之間不斷改變的權力組合。
peopleEn: Foday Sankoh was the best-known leader of the Revolutionary United Front and had received military training in Liberia. He crossed into Sierra Leone in 1991 with a few dozen armed men, rapidly expanded his influence along frontier roads and town positions, and at times temporarily lost direct control of the forward force. President Joseph Saidu Momoh held national authority in 1991 and relied on the Sierra Leone Army for the early counteroffensives. David Lansine was a senior figure in that military command structure and organized pursuit operations in the south and east. Charles Taylor brought Liberia’s civil war directly into Sierra Leone; although his July 1991 force was defeated, he continued supporting Sankoh from outside. In April 1992 Valentine Strasser, John Amadu Bangura and other officers overthrew Momoh and formed the National Provisional Ruling Council. Strasser retained state power until 1997. Andrew Juxon-Smith staged another coup in March 1995, after which Nigerian intervention restored Momoh. In May of the following year Julius Maada Bio and Bangura overthrew the provisional council, and Ahmad Tejan Kabbah assumed state power in July. His government became the central authority confronting the RUF and pursuing United Nations-sponsored settlements. From 1994, Issa Sesay rebuilt and commanded the RUF’s field forces in the east while Sankoh spent more time abroad. The military conflict was therefore not a simple contest between two fixed commands. It involved shifting combinations involving Strasser and Bio as military leaders, Kabbah and other political authorities, Sankoh and Sesay as insurgent commanders, and the commanders of foreign forces.
kits: 以1991年為界，雙方可確認的典型槍械包括：塞拉利昂軍常見的FN FAL 7.62×51毫米步槍（1953年列裝）、L1A1 SLR 7.62毫米步槍（1950年代）、Browning Hi-Power 9×19毫米手槍（1935年）及Sterling 9毫米衝鋒槍（1944年）；革命聯合陣線與利比里亞武裝則除繳獲上述武器外，也使用AK-47及AKM 7.62×39毫米步槍（1947年、1959年）、PKM通用機槍（1969年）、G3 7.62毫米步槍（1957年）與RPG-7反裝甲火箭筒（1961年）。政府軍及西非部隊的支援火力可見FN MAG、M2HB 12.7毫米重機槍和81毫米迫擊砲；英軍使用L16A1 81毫米迫擊砲（1965年），法軍使用Brandt 81毫米迫擊砲。英國部隊另有MILAN反坦克飛彈（1950年代）、Heckler & Koch MP5衝鋒槍（1966年），法國部隊配備FAMAS步槍（1978年）。車輛方面，Land Rover 110（1983年）、Toyota Land Cruiser 70（1984年）、Panhard AML輪式裝甲車（1972年）及Renault VAB裝甲運兵車（1976年）均已在1991年前投入軍用。實際戰鬥最棘手的是彈藥不能互換：7.62×51毫米北約彈、7.62×39毫米、9毫米手槍彈、12.7毫米重機槍彈及81毫米迫擊砲彈須分別採購；即使同一支武裝隊伍繳獲大量步槍，也未必取得相應槍機與瞄具，而輪式車輛同樣需要輪胎、燃油、備件及維修人員。
kitsEn: Using 1991 as the cutoff, the principal weapons confirmed on both sides included the FN FAL 7.62×51mm rifle, adopted in 1953, the L1A1 SLR 7.62mm rifle of the 1950s, the Browning Hi-Power 9×19mm pistol of 1935 and the Sterling 9mm submachine gun of 1944. The RUF and Liberian armed groups used captured examples of these weapons alongside the AK-47 and AKM 7.62×39mm rifles of 1947 and 1959, the PKM general-purpose machine gun of 1969, the G3 7.62mm rifle of 1957 and the RPG-7 anti-tank rocket launcher of 1961. Support fire available to government and West African units included the FN MAG, the M2HB 12.7mm heavy machine gun and 81mm mortars. British troops used the L16A1 81mm mortar, introduced in 1965, while French forces used the Brandt 81mm mortar. British forces also carried the MILAN anti-tank missile from the 1950s and the Heckler & Koch MP5 of 1966, while French troops fielded the FAMAS rifle introduced in 1978. Vehicles already in military service included the Land Rover 110 of 1983, Toyota Land Cruiser 70 of 1984, Panhard AML wheeled armoured car of 1972 and Renault VAB armoured personnel carrier of 1976. Ammunition compatibility was the sharpest logistical problem. 7.62×51mm NATO cartridges, 7.62×39mm ammunition, 9mm pistol ammunition, 12.7mm machine-gun ammunition and 81mm mortar bombs had to be procured separately. A unit might capture many rifles without securing compatible actions, sights or magazines, while wheeled vehicles required equally scarce tyres, fuel, spare parts and trained maintenance personnel.
tactics: 1991年3月的突破依靠小分隊滲透，而不是正面攻整座城市。桑科的人沿邊境公路進入，利用突然襲擊奪取通訊器材、武器和車輛，再以小股武裝分散控制道路交叉點；政府軍仍以縱隊沿主要公路追擊，卻經常在狹窄路段、彎道及兩側高地遭伏擊。革命聯合陣線常先攻擊車隊前部或側翼，使縱隊分段，再由後方小組接近；若未能摧毀道路與補給點，便撤回鄉間重新集結。1991年7月，泰勒率約百人的利比里亞隊伍正面攻擊凱內馬與博城，卻因通信、協同及後援不足而迅速潰退，這次失敗反而顯示一次正面車隊攻擊難以取代地方控制。塞拉利昂政府軍得到西非部隊後，在弗里敦、博城、凱內馬及通往凱拉洪的道路建立封鎖、巡邏與臨時據點；各國分遣隊通常分別使用自己的通信網，無法深入內陸維持連續防線。1991年巴拉斯行動以數百名英軍在隆基及弗里敦集結，沿弗里敦至滑鐵盧方向建立安全線，迫使遠離首都的武裝退回；英軍沒有把行動延伸為佔領東部全境。1992年法軍的 impasse 行動同樣以短暫推進為主，1993年的 pudraque 行動才深入凱拉洪方向，攻破營地、奪取武器與補給後撤回。1999年英軍在弗里敦以機場、港口和主要公路為軸，與尼日利亞部隊協同，切斷攻入城內的武裝後方。2000年後，聯合國軍與政府軍反覆執行駐點、交火、解武和武裝集結區監督，革命聯合陣線則以地方分隊、游擊及重新集結對抗，最終在政府與聯合國部隊協同封路、逐個奪取據點的攻勢下分離，轉入停火與解除武裝程序。
tacticsEn: The opening move of March 1991 depended on small infiltrating groups rather than a frontal assault on a major city. Sankoh’s men entered along frontier roads, used surprise attacks to seize communications equipment, weapons and vehicles, and then dispersed small teams to control road junctions. Government forces continued to pursue them in columns along the main roads, but were frequently ambushed at narrow bends and elevated ground beside the road. The RUF commonly struck the front or flank of a convoy, separated it into isolated sections and sent smaller groups forward from behind. When they failed to destroy a road junction or supply point, they withdrew into the countryside and reassembled. In July 1991, Taylor led roughly one hundred men from Liberia in direct attacks toward Kenema and Bo, but the force collapsed because of inadequate communications, coordination and follow-up. That defeat demonstrated that a frontal convoy attack could not substitute for sustained local control. After West African troops arrived, government forces established blockhouses, patrols and temporary positions around Freetown, Bo, Kenema and the roads to Kailahun. The national contingents generally used separate communications networks and could not maintain a continuous front deep inside the country. Operation Barras concentrated several hundred British troops at Lungi and Freetown, established a secure line toward Waterloo and forced the armed force threatening the capital to withdraw. Britain did not extend the operation into a permanent occupation of the east. France’s 1992 Operation Impass likewise made only a limited advance, while Operation Boudraque in 1993 pushed deeper toward Kailahun, struck camps, captured weapons and supplies and then withdrew. In the 1999 fighting for Freetown, British forces worked around the airport, port and principal roads alongside Nigerian troops and cut the rear areas of the force that had entered the city. From 2000, UN and government troops repeatedly conducted patrols, firefights, disarmament operations and cantonment supervision. The RUF countered through local bands, raiding and reconsolidation. They were finally separated by coordinated government and UN offensives that sealed roads and reduced strongpoints one by one, after which they entered cease-fire and demobilization arrangements.
data: 1991年3月25日首批武裝越過利比里亞邊境，3月底控制凱拉洪，4月相繼向凱內馬與博城發動攻擊；政府軍在邊境公路反擊後迫使前線一度後退。7月，泰勒的利比里亞部隊進入塞拉利昂並受挫。9月首批尼日利亞部隊抵達，ECOMOG正式介入；12月武裝再度向弗里敦逼近，英軍於12月13日至19日執行巴拉斯行動，解放首都東側接近路線，1992年1月初撤出。1992年3月6日至7日塞拉利昂軍因欠薪、指揮爭議及彈藥不足發生兵變，4月29日莫莫被推翻。10月至12月法軍執行 impasse 行動，12月革命聯合陣線再次直攻弗里敦；1993年3月至4月法軍以 pudraque 行動深入東部，摧毀前線營地及軍火庫，迫使桑科退回境外。1994年伊薩·塞塞在東部重建武裝，1995年3月傑克森-史密斯政變被尼日利亞軍方推翻；1997年5月17日比奧與班古拉再度奪權，7月卡巴接掌政府。1998年7月25日政府、革命聯合陣線與西非共同體在洛美簽署協議，但解除武裝未落實。1999年1月6日武裝攻入弗里敦，英軍隨即部署數百人並配合尼日利亞部隊反擊；同年11月聯合國安理會授權UNAMSIL，部隊於2000年全面展開。2002年政府與聯合國部隊發動攻勢，切斷革命聯合陣線控制區的公路與據點；8月31日UNAMSIL撤離，9月18日雙方宣布停止戰鬥。補給方面，聯軍物資經洛美、蒙羅維亞及海空線送入弗里敦或洛貢區域，法軍與後續聯合國部隊則依賴幾內亞南部陸路；六至十月雨季削弱道路通行，卡車、燃料、輪胎、7.62毫米兩制式彈藥、9毫米手槍彈與迫擊砲彈均須分線籌運。各方對戰果的宣稱常互相矛盾，因此可核對的日期、部署、路線與裝備比未經證實的傷亡總數更可靠。
dataEn: The first armed groups crossed the Liberian frontier on 25 March 1991, took Kailahun by the end of the month and attacked Kenema and Bo in April. Government counterattacks along the frontier roads forced the forward force back for a time. Taylor entered Sierra Leone with his Liberian force in July and was defeated. The first Nigerian troops arrived in September, formalizing ECOMOG’s intervention. When armed forces again approached Freetown in December, Britain conducted Operation Barras from 13 to 19 December, opening the approaches east of the capital, and began withdrawing in early January 1992. Sierra Leone Army mutinies broke out on 6 and 7 March 1992 over unpaid service, command disputes and inadequate ammunition; Momoh was overthrown on 29 April. France mounted Operation Impass from October to December, while the RUF attacked Freetown directly again in December. Operation Boudraque in March and April 1993 drove deep into the east, destroyed forward camps and ammunition stores and pushed Sankoh back across the frontier. In 1994 Issa Sesay rebuilt the insurgent force in the east. Andrew Juxon-Smith’s March 1995 coup was overturned by Nigerian military intervention. Julius Maada Bio and John Amadu Bangura seized power again on 17 May 1997, and Kabbah took over the government in July. On 25 July 1998 the government, the RUF and ECOWAS signed the Lomé agreement, but its disarmament provisions were not implemented. On 6 January 1999 armed forces entered Freetown, prompting the deployment of several hundred British troops in cooperation with Nigerian units. The Security Council authorized UNAMSIL in November 1999, and the mission expanded across the country in 2000. In 2002 government and UN forces launched an offensive that cut roads and strongpoints in RUF-held areas. UNAMSIL departed on 31 August, and the parties announced an end to hostilities on 18 September. Coalition supplies moved through Lomé and Monrovia by sea and air to Freetown and the Lokoja area, while French and later UN forces depended on the southern route through Guinea. The June-to-October rains reduced road capacity, and trucks, fuel, tyres, the two incompatible 7.62mm ammunition types, 9mm pistol ammunition and mortar bombs all required separate transport arrangements. Competing claims about battlefield results were frequently contradictory, making verifiable dates, deployments, routes and equipment more reliable than unconfirmed aggregate casualty figures.
cause: 戰爭爆發的直接原因是1991年3月桑科武裝越境，但能迅速發展成全國性內戰，源於塞拉利昂國家權力長期 military 化與軍隊制度失衡。塞拉利昂在1970年代建立一黨政治，1985年又由軍方推翻文官政府；政府、軍隊、貿易收益與地區勢力之間缺乏穩定規則。到1991年，軍方指揮層分裂，基層長期面臨欠薪、訓練不足、維修困難與彈藥分配不均，1992年的兵變因此同時具有政治和軍務背景。外部因素更為直接：查爾斯·泰勒需要塞拉利昂東南部作為利比里亞內戰的外交與軍事支撐，革命聯合陣線則得到境外訓練、武器、safehouse與跨境補給；桑科早年受訓的利比利亞及利比亞通道，使首批隊伍得以在政府邊防薄弱時迅速進入。鑽石產區、邊境貿易與武裝徵收又被用來維持軍費，使地方控制與補給路線變得比首都爭奪更重要。ECOWAS雖多次派兵、調解及要求停火，但多國部隊各自受命於本國政府，無法維持一致的內陸戰略；武器禁運和跨境封鎖亦缺乏持續執行。於是原本可由數百人滲透、有限邊界衝突處理的局勢，逐步變成政府軍、鄰國武裝與跨國聯軍共同參與的消耗戰。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was the March 1991 incursion by Sankoh’s fighters, but the conflict became a nationwide civil war because Sierra Leone’s state power had long been militarized and its armed forces were structurally unstable. Sierra Leone had established a one-party political system during the 1970s, and the military overthrew the government in 1985. There was no stable settlement linking the government, armed forces, trade revenues and regional influence. By 1991 the senior command was fragmented, while regular personnel faced prolonged arrears, inadequate training, poor maintenance and unequal ammunition distribution. The 1992 mutiny therefore had both political and military causes. External factors were even more direct. Charles Taylor needed Sierra Leone’s southeast as diplomatic and military support for Liberia’s civil war, while the RUF obtained foreign training, weapons, safe houses and cross-border supply. The Liberian and Libyan channels through which Sankoh had trained allowed the first groups to enter quickly wherever border surveillance was thin. Control of diamond areas, frontier trade and armed collection became more important than possession of the capital because these resources financed the fighting forces. ECOWAS repeatedly dispatched troops, mediated cease-fires and demanded disarmament, but each national contingent remained answerable to its own government, preventing a coherent strategy deep inside Sierra Leone. Arms embargoes and border controls were not consistently enforced. An incursion involving several hundred men and a limited frontier dispute therefore developed into a consuming war involving the national army, neighboring armed groups and multinational forces.
impact: 最直接的軍事影響，是塞拉利昂軍在1992年4月兵變後遭解散，國家臨時統治委員會另建武裝，舊有指揮、訓練與補給體系因而進一步分裂。其後三年間，斯特拉瑟、比奧及傑克森-史密斯發動或參與的政變反覆改變指揮系統，使前線單位必須頻繁調整效忠對象與補給來源。革命聯合陣線則不再只是邊境游擊隊，而能在凱拉洪、凱內馬、博城及東部鄉間建立地方控制網，以縱隊、分散分隊和道路補給維持作戰；其軍事實力因而不會因一次城市攻勢失敗而消失。弗里敦在1991年12月、1992年12月及1999年1月屢次受到直屬攻擊，首都外圍公路、港口與機場也由正常軍用節點變成外國部隊必須保障的戰略要地。對區域而言，泰勒直接介入塞拉利昂使利比里亞內戰獲得更多武器、經驗與外交縱深，之後解放陣線攻占蒙羅維亞的行動亦受此影響。國際介入則由ECOMOG過渡到UNAMSIL，並伴隨武器禁運、解除武裝方案與特別法庭；1998年洛美協議雖建立政治框架，卻因核查、武器儲存與武裝團體指揮權問題未能阻止戰事再起。
impactEn: The most direct military effect was the dissolution of the Sierra Leone Army after the April 1992 mutiny and the creation of a new armed force under the National Provisional Ruling Council, further fragmenting the existing chain of command, training and supply. The coups staged or joined by Strasser, Bio and Juxon-Smith over the next three years repeatedly changed the command structure, forcing front-line units to realign their allegiance and resupply arrangements. The RUF was no longer merely a frontier raiding force. It developed a local control network around Kailahun, Kenema, Bo and the eastern countryside, sustaining operations through columns, dispersed bands and road-based supply. Its military organization consequently survived the failure of frontal attacks on the capital. Freetown was directly threatened in December 1991, December 1992 and January 1999, while roads, the port and the airport around the capital changed from routine military nodes into strategic positions that foreign forces had to secure. Regionally, Taylor’s direct intervention gave Liberia’s civil war additional weapons, experience and diplomatic depth, later assisting the NPFL’s capture of Monrovia. International involvement shifted from ECOMOG to UNAMSIL and was accompanied by arms embargoes, disarmament arrangements and a special court. Although the 1998 Lomé agreement created a political framework, disputes over verification, weapons storage and command over armed groups prevented it from stopping renewed fighting.
result: 2002年的結局不是革命聯合陣線被在戰場上消滅，而是它在戰局失去主動後仍有組織地轉入停火。年初政府軍與UNAMSIL協調封閉道路、奪取據點，革命聯合陣線一度反擊弗里敦及聯合國設施區，卻未能重新控制首都與主要交通網；至年中，政府和聯合國部隊已切斷多數前線據點與外來補給，革命聯合陣線只能退入仍受其節制的零散鄉間區域。8月31日UNAMSIL完成任務並撤離，9月18日雙方宣布停止敵對行動，解除武裝與部隊集結程序開始執行，卡巴政府隨即宣告內戰結束。特別法庭同日起訴桑科等武裝領導人，但這是司法程序，不是戰役勝負的替代。政治上，卡巴政府保住了國家中央的地位，革命聯合陣線則把原有政治與軍事組織轉入合法政黨並參加2002年選舉。軍事結論因此是兩方都未被完全摧毀：政府避免了國家中樞被永久奪取，革命聯合陣線則未能攻佔並維持整個國家，只能以談判、解除武裝及政治轉換結束長期戰鬥。
resultEn: The war did not end with the RUF being annihilated on the battlefield. Instead, after losing operational initiative, it remained organized enough to enter a cease-fire. Early in 2002 government forces and UNAMSIL coordinated road closures and the seizure of strongpoints. The RUF briefly counterattacked around Freetown and UN facilities, but it could not regain the capital or the main transport network. By the middle of the year, government and UN troops had cut many forward positions off from external supply, forcing the RUF back into scattered rural areas where it still exercised control. UNAMSIL completed its mission and departed on 31 August. On 18 September the parties announced an end to hostilities, began implementing demobilization and regrouping arrangements, and Kabbah declared the civil war over. On the same day the Special Court indicted Foday Sankoh and other armed leaders, but this judicial process was not a substitute for a battlefield decision. Politically, the Kabbah government retained the central institutions of the state. The RUF converted its surviving political-military organization into a legal political party and contested the 2002 elections. The military conclusion was therefore that neither side was completely destroyed. The government prevented the permanent seizure of the national center, while the RUF failed to capture and retain the entire country and could finish the war only through negotiated cease-fire, disarmament and political conversion.
